name: dynamics-connection-compatibility
title: Build the official-NuGet Dynamics 365 access gateway
description: Build a shared Dynamics 365 8.2/9.1 access gateway using separately version-pinned Microsoft CrmServiceClient worker processes, with SDK-free product/Gateway boundaries, deterministic worker recycling, zero session/resource leakage, and removal of direct Web API and Data8 routes.
creator: codex
notes: 2026-08-02 direction correction: direct Web API and the D365APP01 CRMWeb/IFD management-diagnostic channel are no longer supported routes or Phase 4 blockers. The only new transports are separately version-pinned net48 Microsoft CrmServiceClient workers for CE 8.2 and CE 9.1. Existing WebApi scripts/projects are legacy replacement inputs pending removal; Data8 remains only for explicitly unmigrated traffic. Preserve the completed LocalDB cross-process capacity/fault evidence and existing Gateway isolation/lifecycle foundations. Package01FeeReadsEnabled remains false until its matching Phase 4 gates pass.
nextAction: Production now routes Gateway -> ControlPlane/WorkerSupervisor -> separate CE 8.2 or CE 9.1 net48 Microsoft CrmServiceClient official-NuGet worker -> Organization Service. D365APP01 IFD, HTTP WhoAmI, and direct Web API are not Phase 4 gates. Finish the remaining worker-neutral test migrations; run the complete build/test plus boundary, deterministic cleanup/no-leak, fault, and soak gates; replace deployment worker-hash placeholders with the exact published executable hashes; then validate the deployed website -> Gateway -> official worker -> CE compatibility matrix. Do not mark an unverified gate passed.
